suggested_experiment_name: Spectroscopy / Coulomb law tests on hidden photons
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless (as plotted Log10 chi)
notes: Paper constrains hidden photon kinetic mixing chi via deviations from Coulomb's law using atomic spectroscopy (Lamb shift in H, He ions, muonic hydrogen, true muonium). The mass range spans roughly keV to >MeV for m_gamma'. However, the bounds are presented only as curves in figures (Figs 1, 3, 4, 5) with no numerical tabulated (mass, chi) pairs. The bounds do not improve on existing constraints except for speculative future measurements.
